title: Physical-iPhone Analysis performance evidence harness / device telemetry hardening

records: resident bytes and physical footprint when TASK_VM_INFO is available
battery level/state samples and raw delta/drain
cooperative cancellation request/termination offsets and derived latency

anti_fabrication: simulator runtime can never produce physical-device status
unavailable telemetry is nil plus an explicit reason, never numeric zero
samples and pressure events must be monotonic and bounded by wall time
manifest ID and SHA-256 must match the exact HQ-selected corpus
complete-analysis and cancellation-probe semantics cannot be mixed
telemetry arrays are bounded by the configured maximum sample count
validated_cases: structurally complete physical-device-shaped record summarizes peak memory, thermal transitions, battery delta and warning count without declaring PASS
cancellation latency is derived from monotonic request/termination offsets
unavailable memory remains explicit incomplete telemetry
complete run carrying cancellation timestamps fails closed
limitations: No physical iPhone was used in this wave.
No rights-cleared production long-track Analysis run was executed.
UIKit/Darwin collector code is guarded out on Linux; its active Apple-SDK compile remains an HQ Xcode gate.
Portable validator timings are not iPhone Analysis wall-time or battery/thermal/memory measurements.
W23 defines no production thresholds for wall time, memory, thermal state, battery drain or cancellation latency.
